correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified all 1458 matrices with exact integer arithmetic: every file is 36x36 (0,1) with all row/column sums 15 and NN^T=N^TN=9I+6J, and independent GF(3) RREF gives rank exactly 18 for all 1458 (rankset {18}). Self-duality follows rigorously: row weight 15=0 mod 3 and pairwise intersections 6=0 mod 3 give self-orthogonality (confirmed directly G=0 mod 3), plus dimension 18 at half length. Minimum-distance code minweight36.c was source-reviewed: RREF basis, enforced systematization, 9+9 MITM covering all 3^18 words, bit-exact GF(3) packed addition verified exhaustively, zero word excluded. Rebuilt binary reproduces RANK 18/MINWEIGHT 6 on representative and 13 spot samples; independent Python MITM on gsdes18_1000.txt exhibits an explicit weight-6 codeword and exhaustively excludes weights 1,2,3,4 and all 12M weight-5 words, so d=6 exactly. Sweep log covers all 1458 files 1:1 with RANK 18 MINWEIGHT 6. Distinctness holds as 1458 distinct SHA-256 file hashes and 1458 distinct matrices. Isomorphism classification is honestly disclaimed, so no overclaim.

originality.rationale: Fused retrieval (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE) plus full-text review of the nearest prior (Rukavina-Tonchev arXiv:2209.13468) shows no prior covers the headline. The closest results classify symmetric 2-(36,15,6) designs spanning EXTREMAL [36,18,12] codes (unique design with group order 24 spanning Pless C(17)), or enumerate Hadamards inside C(17) (Tonchev 2021), or study near-extremal codes with d=9 (Harada-Ishizuka). The submitted claim is the opposite corner: rank-18 designs spanning [36,18,6] codes with d=6, which those extremal/near-extremal theorems neither state nor imply. No table or database lists these 1458 Goethals-Seidel matrices with exact [36,18,6] identification; equivalent Hadamard/regular-Hadamard/Menon/3-rank phrasings and broader length-36 extremal censuses were tested and do not subsume a d=6 classification. See decisive_checks for the adversarial checklist.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING verified as genuinely target-generated: target_exit.json records the target BLOCKED after four routes (~8000 verified designs), and the 1458-case GS extremality sweep used the target's own success machinery (exact design equations, exact dimension, exact minimum distance). Judged under the ordinary standard with no presumption, the headline is an exact, non-trivial, pre-motivated invariant of classical natural objects: symmetric 2-(36,15,6) designs are central to the extremal length-36 ternary-code problem, rank 18 is not automatic (Williamson ranks 16, Menon 12/14 in the same session), self-duality plus exact distance 6 required exhaustive 3^18 checks per design and is not mechanically implied. It converts the target into a quantified barrier (rank-18 spanning plentiful yet extremality uniformly absent) with reusable certified artifacts and a calibrated toolchain a future researcher could directly need. Narrowness alone does not defeat value per STANDARD; the incomplete surrounding census is honestly disclaimed while the headline datum stands alone.
